text: ATHCIEVE. This item is derived from the French _abarne_, i.c. to fish or make an end of his figurities, in heredity, to prefer green schemes or ex-ploids.

parsed.faithful: ATCHIEVE. This term is derived from the French achever, i. e. to finish or make an end of; but signifies, in heraldry, to perform great actions or exploits.
